application_type_full: Outline planning permission: Some matters reserved
description:
Outline application for the demolition of existing petrol station and re-development of site as Car showroom on ground & first floor with basement, ancillary offices and parts store  together with associated access and car parking. 

(Amended Plans- 07/03/05)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Approval of the details of the siting, design and external appearance of the building, the means of access thereto and the landscaping of the site (hereinafter called "the reserved matters") shall be obtained from the local planning authority in writing before any development is commenced

Condition : 2 - Plans and particulars of the reserved matters referred to in condition 2 above, relating to the siting, design and external appearance of any buildings to be erected, the means of access to the site and the landscaping of the site, shall be submitted in writing to the local planning authority and shall be carried out as approved.
Condition : 3 - Application for approval of the reserved matters shall be made to the local planning authority before the expiration of (three) years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun either before the expiration of (five) years from the date of this permission, or before the expiration of (two) years from the date of approval of the last of the reserved matters to be approved, whichever is the later.
Condition : 6 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - The building shall be constructed so as to provide insulation against external noise.

Condition : 9 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc); proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc); retained historic landscape features and proposals for restoration, where relevant).

Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme)

Condition : 10 - Before the development commences details of parking (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the development.

Condition : 11 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the car showroom shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 12 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the use hereby permitted is commenced in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority).  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 13 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  8am  to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 14 - Details of solar heating panels shall be submitted for approval by the LPA
Condition : 15 - Details of recycling facilitiesshall be submitted for approval by the LPA.
Condition : 16 - The vehicle access on the eastern side of the site shall be no wider than 10m.

Condition : 17 - The transporter will on and off load only within the site and the parking spaces affected by the transporter's turning circle are not marked out.  Existing crossover to be blocked and reconstructed to match existing footway line and level using matching materials.  Details of off street parking shall be submitted for approval by the LPA, prior to commencement.
Condition : 18 - "Existing crossover to be blocked": and reconstructed to match existing footway line and level using matching materials.

Condition : 19 - The building shall not be taken into use until spaces for vehicle parking and deliveries has been provided in accordance with the approved details and drawing (2004-557/SK1).  This area shall, thereafter, be kept available for parking and the use of delivery vehicles.

Condition : 20 - The 22 internal and external designated car parking bays shown on   
 drawing No.1923/21 rev. C received 7/3/2005  shall not be used for   
 purposes for the display or sale of vehicles.

Condition : 21 - An employee Travel Plan shall be  submitted to and approved by the 
 Council and shall all be introduced and put into effect upon  
 commencement of the use hereby permitted and shall thereafter be 
 maintained in place at all times while the car showroom remains in 
 operation.   The operator of the showroom shall provide 
 the Council with a monitoring report at yearly intervals for five years  from  
 the date on which the use commenced, the report shall contain a review 
 of the strategies imposed, the targets identified and the new targets to be  
 achieved.

Condition : 22 - The proposed demolition of the petrol station at 887 Great West Road, and the rebuilding of the site with a purpose built building with off street parking and delivery facilities for the display and sale of motor vehicles, is considered to be an acceptable employment generating use of the site, which will promote and enhance the Great West Road and Syon Lane and  the setting of the nearby Listed building . This is in accordance with policies IMP 4.2 (The Great West Road), IMP 5.1 (High Quality Buildings and Urban Design)  ENVB 1.1 (New Development), ENVB 2.5 (Development affecting the setting of a Listed Building), E 1.5 (Development Involving the Loss of/ changes in Employment Uses) of the London Borough of Hounslow  Unitary Development Plan.  Where the development is not in accordance with the UDP there are considered to be no adverse affects resulting from this.
